plan.summary: Deploy a containerized Python asyncio stream processing workload on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot in us-central1, integrating Cloud Pub/Sub, Workload Identity Federation, Artifact Registry, Cloud Buildpacks, and Firestore Native.
plan.architecture_overview: A GKE Autopilot cluster hosts the stream processing workload in namespace 'stream-apps'. Kubernetes Service Account 'sa-stream-worker' authenticates to Google Cloud APIs via Workload Identity Federation mapped to a least-privilege IAM service account (roles/pubsub.subscriber, roles/datastore.user). The Python asyncio worker pulls streaming events concurrently in batches of 50 from Pub/Sub subscription 'stream-gke-sub', aggregates metrics across 1-minute tumbling windows, and persists aggregate documents to Firestore collection 'stream_metrics'. Deployment manifests specify 1 replica (cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi), liveness/readiness probes, and an HPA autoscaling to 2 pods at 80% CPU utilization. Application containers are built via Cloud Native Buildpacks and published to Artifact Registry before deployment to prevent ImagePullBackOff.

Firestore database initialized

infra_tasks.title: Configure Workload Identity IAM Service Account & Role Bindings

acceptance_criteria: Workload Identity binding declared without static credentials
Least privilege roles bound

infra_tasks.title: Provision GKE Autopilot Cluster and Kubernetes Manifests
infra_tasks.description: Deploy GKE Autopilot cluster with Workload Identity enabled, synthesize and apply Kubernetes manifests for namespace 'stream-apps', KSA 'sa-stream-worker', Deployment 'stream-processor-deployment' referencing the built image from Artifact Registry, and HPA target of 80% CPU (max 2 replicas).
acceptance_criteria: GKE Autopilot cluster deployed
Deployment image matches Artifact Registry build
Namespace, KSA, Deployment, and HPA synthesized

code_tasks.title: Implement Asyncio Pub/Sub Stream Worker & Firestore Aggregator
code_tasks.description: Implement Python asyncio streaming worker using google-cloud-pubsub and google-cloud-firestore. Handle streaming batches of up to 50 events concurrently, aggregate throughput, latency, and error rate over 1-minute tumbling windows, persist summaries to 'stream_metrics', and provide HTTP liveness/readiness health probes on port 8080.
acceptance_criteria: Asyncio worker consumes batches concurrently
1-minute tumbling window metrics persisted to Firestore
HTTP health probe endpoints return 200 OK

code_tasks.title: Build & Publish Stream Worker Container Image via Cloud Buildpacks
code_tasks.description: Package the Python stream processing worker via Cloud Native Buildpacks and publish the resulting container image to Artifact Registry repository 'stream-workloads' so it is available before Kubernetes manifests deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Container image built successfully via Buildpacks
Image pushed to Artifact Registry repository

code_tasks.title: Implement Unit & Integration Tests for Stream Processing Pipeline
code_tasks.description: Develop pytest test suite with mock fixtures for Pub/Sub async pull streaming, tumbling window aggregation logic, and Firestore client persistence with 100% passing rate.
acceptance_criteria: All pytest unit tests pass with mocked GCP clients
Health probe responses validated

plan.risk_assessment: GKE Autopilot cluster provisioning is heavy stateful and takes 10 to 15 minutes, requiring execution via tf-applier with extended timeout headroom. Container packaging via Cloud Buildpacks is placed in topological sequence before GKE manifest deployment to ensure the image exists in Artifact Registry, preventing ImagePullBackOff. Workload Identity eliminates static secret credentials.
